observations.name: official_pedestrian_exclusive_designation
observations.description: Original source-bound official pedestrian exclusive designation

runtime_uncertainties: A physical marker or colored rendering alone does not establish official pedestrian-only designation.
The unverified-designation contrast is an evidence-source contrast; it does not assert that the designation is legally absent.
Any frame-overlap or synthetic fixture result is a geometric diagnostic, not a legal determination.

evidence_review.method: Reviewed the exact NRS 484B.110 text, conditional witness and zero-entry accepted evidence inventory. No physical equivalence is claimed.

gaps.requirement: Original highway, official pedestrian-only safety-zone designation and interval, visible marking/sign, driver/vehicle identity, and body-motion relative to original zone boundaries
gaps.why_existing_insufficient: Frozen evidence.json lists zero accepted recordings; the sole source witness is conditional and physically unverified.

witness_review.branch: through or within a safety zone
required_context: A constructed travel route through or within the zone.
A qualifying motor vehicle under actual physical control of its driver.
Establish eligible vehicle classification and driver attribution.
Establish highway boundaries, dedication to a public authority, and public vehicular access.
Highway boundaries, public-authority dedication and public vehicular access.
Observe vehicle extent and motion relative to the zone without treating a single overlap frame as a legal determination.
Official pedestrian-only zone designation, boundaries and designation interval.
Plain markings or proper signs and evidence of their visibility throughout that interval.
Retain markings or proper signs and continuing visibility evidence without assigning visibility thresholds.
Retain official pedestrian-only designation, boundaries, and designation interval.
witness_review.reason: A paved-road travel route can pass through an officially designated safety zone; zone presence alone does not establish that movement.
